title: When the bottleneck moves: how engineering teams reorganise around agents
thesis: AI raised the volume of code but not the output. The constraint moved from writing to review. The teams that improved delivery without degrading stability moved intent into a verifiable artifact and changed who owns what; teams that only added agents got the volume without the gain.
audience: Engineering leaders and senior engineers deciding how to reorganise delivery with coding agents, 2026-2027
